name: Spitetooth

abilities.name: Crush
abilities.description: Upon landing in the area, Spitetooth deals very high physical damage in its landing area.

abilities.name: Bat
abilities.description: Basic melee attack dealing high physical damage.

abilities.name: Claw Strike
abilities.description: Basic melee attack dealing high physical damage.

abilities.name: Tear
abilities.description: Charged melee attack dealing high physical damage and very briefly snaring. This can be blocked to stagger Spitetooth.

abilities.name: Pounce
abilities.description: Spitetooth jumps on a target, dealing high physical damage in a area.

abilities.name: Tail Swipe
abilities.description: Spitetooth swipes its tail in front of them, snaring, dealing moderate physical damage instantly and moderate poison damage over 4 seconds.

abilities.name: Smoke Breath
abilities.description: Spitetooth breaths a smoke mist on the ground that slowly chases a target, dealing continuous moderate magic damage and snaring.

abilities.name: Charging Strike
abilities.description: Spitetooth charges towards an enemy, dealing damage. If blocked it staggers Spitetooth.

abilities.name: Bellow
abilities.description: When Spitetooth reaches 50% health, both bosses roar which fears all targets and Bloodmane jumps in to fight you.

abilities.name: Enrage
abilities.description: When Bloodmane dies first, Spitetooth enrages for a moment which greatly increases its damage output and reduces its damage taken.

summary: Spitetooth and Bloodmane are a pair of tharrikers acting as one of the bosses of Silorn. Bloodmane will jump down from its ledge and join the fight when Spitetooth reaches 50% of its health.
